entries.1c4276493fa14157: This is a group of cloud services that supports the entire brokerage process, from acquiring property information through attracting customers, applications, explanation of important matters and contracts. Built on the inter-broker property distribution service 'Riapro ＢＢ＋ (Plus)', the company provides 'ＷｅｂＭａｎａｇｅｒＰｒｏ' website creation support, 'Property Data Linkage' portal listing support, and, for non-face-to-face procedures, 'Electronic Move-in Application Service', 'ＩＴ Jusetsu' and 'Electronic Contract Service'. entries.a4c71c37ead13de3: This is a single-segment business that provides end-to-end cloud-based business support services for the real estate industry. It is divided into 2 categories: 'Brokerage Solutions', which support brokerage operations, and 'Management Solutions', which support rental property management operations, and it also collaborates with partner companies such as rent guarantee companies and financial institutions. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥5,472 million.
